question: From which knot do the three elements proceed in this teaching?
premises: The reference point is the brahma knot
Something is situated there and proceeds from it
There are indeed three, addressed to the beautiful-faced one
inference: The three proceed from the location of the brahma knot.
uncertainties: The exact referent of etāṃ and trīṇi is context-dependent
plain_english: Situated at the brahma knot, from there proceed these three indeed, O beautiful-faced one.
